subject: Token-rate triangulation & next steps — pricing handshake
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha King <samantha@careco.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Token-rate triangulation & next steps — pricing handshake

Hi Samantha — great call earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap + asks so we can lock a price anchor for the pilot: 

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + multi-turn context retrieval for 18 months of chat history.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~150M tokens/month, peak bursts up to ~400M in promo windows.
- Latency target: 200-400ms p50 for short generations (<=128 tokens), some longer tail allowed for batch offline jobs.
- Security: preference for EU/US data residency, SOC2 and KMS integration critical.

Key asks from our side to firm a commercial:
1) Confirm expected monthly token range (low / mid / high) you can commit to for the 90-day pilot. A single number + upside % is fine.
2) Budget posture: is the evaluation pilot funded from a separate budget (PO) or part of Q1 production budget? Rough budget band (USD) helps.
3) Any hard constraints on per-1M token targets? You mentioned wanting something materially below what you pay today.

Benchmark context (attached spreadsheet has full line items):
- OpenAI (gpt-4 style) public anchors we see in market: ~$1,000–1,400 per 1M tokens for comparable generation workloads (depending on prompt length/embedding usage).
- Anthropic-like system: typically ~10–15% below top OpenAI list prices in many enterprise deals, but still >$900/1M in most public comparators.
- Open-model hosts / self-hosted + managed variants: unit costs can be much lower (we see $300–$500/1M for certain optimized Llama/Redwood variants at scale) but vary by latency/QA, quantization, and KV cache hit rates.

Preliminary anchor ranges we think are realistic for the pilot (will refine when you confirm volume):
- Pilot (no-commit eval): $900–1,100 per 1M tokens (metered, short-term credits possible)
- Small committed pilot (>=100M/mo): $700–850 per 1M with modest commit & limited SLA
- Enterprise reserved (>=1.5B tokens/yr): $400–600 per 1M with stronger SLA and dedicated pool

Attached: pricing-comparison-20261117.xlsx (tabs: summary, per-feature deltas, SLA add-ons) and a draft SOW (SOW_v0.3.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm monthly token band and budget band by EOD Thu 11/19.
- We schedule a 30-min pricing/ops call (Ben + Laura join) to finalize anchor and procurement path.
- I’ll circulate an updated one-page SOW after that call.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk the spreadsheet.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: pricing-comparison-20261117.xlsx (spreadsheet, 4 tabs)
Attachment: SOW_v0.3.pdf (1-page draft)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap and the spreadsheet. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume: for the pilot program we can commit to a 90-day pilot target of 250M tokens/month (this is our mid-case). Low-case ~120M/mo, high-case up to 420M/mo during a promotional tranche if things go well.
2) Budget: pilot has a separate PoC budget; approximate budget band for the 90-day trial is $150k–$220k total.
3) Target unit: we are looking for a per-1M anchor at or below $700 if we commit to the 250M/month pilot. If you need an absolute baseline without commit, we expect something in the $850–950/1M range to consider.
4) Residency: US-only OK for now, but EU tenancy will be required if we expand to EU customers next year. SOC2 required, ok to share certs.

Procurement: procurement will want a 1-page SOW + sample invoice + PO terms (Net30). Rafael (cc) is our procurement lead — I’ve looped him for visibility.

Happy to take the ops call next Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

—Sam
Samantha King
Head of Machine Learning | CareCo Health
samantha@careco.ai | +1 (646) 555-8830

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Token-rate triangulation & next steps — pricing handshake

Samantha — looping in a few practical price scenarios so you have explicit numeric options before the ops call. Camila and I discussed tradeoffs with Laura (pricing/finance). High level: we can hit your $700/1M target if CareCo commits to the 250M/mo pilot with a short-term committed credit structure and a 90-day close window. Below are three concrete options (numbers are USD per 1M tokens):

Scenario A — No-commit evaluation (fast onboarding):
- Unit: $950/1M
- Term: Metered 30–90 day trial; startup credits available to offset first 60 days
- SLA: best-effort, 99.5% control plane availability

Scenario B — Committed pilot (recommended):
- Unit: $700/1M (meets Sam’s target)
- Commitment: 250M tokens/month for 90 days (min invoice commitment = 250M * 90 days / 30 = 750M tokens billed monthly as committed volume)
- SLA: 99.9% compute availability; 4-hour incident response; regional placement US
- Add-on: EU tenancy available as an add-on for an incremental charge (we can price separately)

Scenario C — Enterprise reserved (best unit economics):
- Unit: $450/1M
- Commitment: annual reserved 1.5B+ tokens (prepay or committed spend)
- SLA: Dedicated GPU pool, 99.95% availability, priority capacity during peaks

Benchmarks (public comparators we often see):
- OpenAI (recent enterprise anchors for generation): ~$1,000–1,400/1M depending on volume and embedding mix
- Anthropic enterprise: ~$900–1,100/1M in many public deals
- Managed open-model hosts (optimized Llama-family on dedicated infra): ~$300–$600/1M depending on latency/quality/quantization profile

Notes and tradeoffs:
- Cache hit-rate and prompt length materially shift effective per-token CPU usage; if you can push more context caching to client side we’ll pass more savings through.
- Committed pilots allow us to allocate dedicated capacity and a tailored quantization profile for your workload (big wins for cost).
- If procurement needs PO terms, Laura is your contact (she’ll attach standard SOW + sample invoice).

If you’re comfortable we’ll aim to (1) lock Scenario B for the 90-day pilot and (2) push a one-page SOW + invoice template before the ops call. Suggested times: Wed 11/24 2pm PST or Thu 11/25 10am PST.

Thanks — Ben Carter
Principal Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0166
